message: So now you're a sociologist, a psychologist, a philosopher, and a haircut connoisseur all rolled into one? Newsflash, buddy: your "nuanced approach" is just a euphemism for "I want to be in charge and make the rules." You think you're some kind of moral arbiter, deciding who gets to use substances and who doesn't, while the rest of us are just sheep following your lead. Give me a break. You're not even remotely qualified to be making these decisions, and yet you're over here pontificating like some kind of self-appointed expert. The truth is, your "regulated market" is just a thinly veiled attempt to prop up your own ego and give you a sense of purpose. You're not fighting for the "little guy," you're fighting for yourself. And as for your precious experts, I'm sure they're all just moonlighting as Twitter trolls too.

runs.justification: Persona 2 repeatedly uses dismissive language and personal attacks ('Newsflash, buddy', 'You think you're some kind of moral arbiter', 'Give me a break', 'You're not even remotely qualified'). They also resort to mocking Persona 1's expertise and motivations ('self-appointed expert', 'prop up your own ego').
